notes.title: Update - MONTH 8
notes.content:
Greetings, Music Store Simulator players! 

We're thrilled to bring you the latest enhancements and fixes in our [b]Month 8 update[/b]. As always, your feedback continues to drive our improvements, and we're excited to introduce features that enhance your gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42500031/bb4cb9521217f32e1f6752c2df433cb7600eeb53.png[/img]

[b]MAJOR CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] A new App has been added in the Studio PC for Warehouses monitoring and management (stats, moving and destroying wares).
[*] Implemented a feature that allows to configure the Auto-Refill system for each Shelf. So, under a specific threshold, the missing items are purchased automatically.
[*] Updated the Delivery System of wares: now the delivery fills automatically slots with the same incoming ware, in order to avoid wasting space.
[*] Added a feature inside the Warehouse App that allows to optimize the slots with the same wares, allowing to save space in the warehouse.
[*] A Naming system for the shelves has been implemented in order to also visually characterize them with specific panels.
[*] Added a new App in the Tablet that allows to purchase items directly from the Shelf through a simulated Augmented Reality feature.
[/list]

[b]MINOR CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] After an Order is deleted in the Market App, the list of Parts and the related Details Panel are emptied in order to avoid unwanted actions.
[*] In the Parts list, in the Market App, if a category of Parts is closed the Details Panel is emptied in order to avoid unwanted actions.
[/list]
[b]MAJOR FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked the building process if the game was saved and reload when the Soldering process was the Next Step.
[*] During the building process, if Painting, Drying or Setting is active, the ghost system is disabled in order to avoid non-consequential actions, which could break the building flow.
[*] Fixed the size of several Instruments in the Private Collection room.
[*] Fixed a problem that forced a further installment payment, after a Loan has been payed off through the PC Homebanking app.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Repair Orders that locked the Project because one of the target Parts was not recognized as replaced.
[*] Solved a problem with the Tours in the Advertising Panel of Brand app. The Tours were not refreshed every day as expected, so it was not possible to activate new Campaigns.
[/list]

[b]MINOR FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the appearance animation of screws in several Parts.
[*] Fixed the layer of Instruments bases which did not allow to be lighted by the workbenches properly.
[*] Fixed a problem that did not allow to highlight properly some Parts in Disassembly mode.
[*] Fixed an issue which blocked the Next Steps Panel to address properly the Parts to be assembled.
[/list]
[b]The game will be updated this Friday, April 12 at 10 pm CET.[/b]

We're committed to delivering the best gaming experience, and your support and feedback continue to be invaluable. Dive into the Month 8 update now and explore these exciting new features and fixes. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update - MONTH 7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42500031/f0003d41dfb1e6c44371bc2fd5e27fc9c1fbb06e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Music Store Simulator Update - MONTH 7[/b][/h3]

[b]Greetings, Simulated Music Masters![/b]

A new month is ended and so a new update to Music Store Simulator has been released!

At the beginning of February we noticed some performance drop due to the new Soldering system, so we had to change our plan.

Indeed, giving you the best game experience as possible is the highest priority for us, so we started to rework deeply the Soldering process, and we focused on it totally.

Obviously, in the meanwhile several further fixes have been completed and also new instruments (that will be released on March the 10th) have been added!

Highlights of this Update:
[b]MAJOR CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Implemented a new process to preload savegames information that makes Main Menu and Pause Menu much faster.
[*]Solved an issue wich did not update the overall Popularity of the Brand after an Order has been completed.
[*]Improved deeply the Soldering process in order to guarantee a higher performance level in low-end systems.
[*]Added the Electric Bass PB5 (to be released on March the 10th)
[*]Added the Acoustic Bass AET (to be released on March the [strike]10th[/strike] 31st)
[*]Added the Electric Guitar FVS (to be released on March the 10th)
[*]Added the Electric Guitar FVT (to be released on March the 10th)
[/list]

[b]MAJOR FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that blocked the Painting process when a layer was selected before selecting the Part to be painted.
[*]Fixed a problem which caused an invalid calculation of the painted area.
[*]Fixed a problem in the Soldering process of Electric SCT, that did not allow to assemble the back plates, and the Order could not be completed.
[*]Solved an issue which did not clean properly a reference to a Project after it was moved from a Drying Shelf.
[/list]

[b]MINOR FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem which hided the HiFi models while building the instruments.
[*]Fixed an issue which did not allow to restore the correct color of customized Workbenches.
[*]Removed the "Reserved" label in old Parts while assembling an Instrument in Repair Orders.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused a negative counter to be displayed when disassembling parts with screws.
[/list]

Thank you again and again for all your great support!
Step by step we get closer and closer to our goal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42500031/c4f631286b3c2e7cf8c12c404c812f9c6cb1e281.png[/img]

notes.title: Update - MONTH 6
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Rockers![/b]

The journey through Early Access has been nothing short of electrifying, and it's all thanks to the vibrant community that has been with us from the demo days. Your passion and feedback have been the driving force behind our progress, and we're thrilled to bring you a game-changing feature that's been on everyone's wishlist since the dawn of Early Access.

[i][b]🔧 MAJOR CHANGES: Soldering Revolution![/b][/i]
Prepare to dive deep into the heart of your electric instruments as we introduce the much-anticipated soldering feature. Now you can skillfully solder electronic elements in guitars like never before! Say hello to a new level of customization as you interact with electric cables and capacitors, adding a unique touch to your musical arsenal.

[i][b]🎸 New Skills Unleashed![/b][/i]
But that's not all - a brand-new skill awaits you in the PC app, designed to turbocharge your soldering process. Your instruments will never be the same, and it's all thanks to your invaluable input. This is a game-changer, and we couldn't be more excited to share it with you!

[i][b]🖱️ MINOR CHANGES: Precision at Your Fingertips[/b][/i]
To enhance your crafting experience, we've added a specific mouse cursor tailored for the soldering process. Precision is the name of the game, and now you have the perfect tool to master it.

[i][b]🛠️ MAJOR FIXES: Silencing the Glitches[/b][/i]
We heard you loud and clear about the issues hindering your creative flow. No more struggles with downloading Audio References files or unexpected halts in the painting process. We've got you covered, ensuring a seamless audio customization and painting experience.

[b][i]🔍 MINOR FIXES: Details Matter[/i][/b]
From revealing hidden HiFi models to refining the AutoConfiguration process, we've ironed out the minor wrinkles that were affecting your gameplay. Your projects will now thrive even in the Painting Room without a hitch.

[i][u][b]Full list of updates[/b][/u][/i]

[b]MAJOR CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented the major feature to solder the electronic elements in electric instruments.
[*] Implemented the interaction to electric cables and capacitors.
[*] Added the Soldering steps in Electric DCT, Electric SCT, Electric TL1 and Electric PST guitars and in Electric Bass PB4.
[*] Added a new Skill in the related PC app in order to speed up the Soldering process.
[/list]
[b]MINOR CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a specific mouse cursor for Soldering process.
[/list]
[b]MAJOR FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem which did not allow to download properly the Audio References file in new installations, blocking the Audio customization.
[*] Fixed an issue which stopped the Painting process when the AutoConfirmation option was active, even same areas were not painted yet.
[/list]
[b]MINOR FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem which hided the HiFi models in the non-Player cameras.
[*] Now, when the AutoConfiguration is used, the preferred Paint selector is shown, instead of the Advanced one.
[*] Fixed a problem which did not allow to retrieve properly a Project while drying in the Painting Room.

notes.content:

[h3][b]New Updates - HOTFIX 3 in Music Store Simulator - Play, Assemble, and Sell Music![/b][/h3]

[h3]Hello, Musicians and Master Luthiers![/h3]

Today, we have the pleasure of presenting to you the latest update in our beloved game, Music Store Simulator. This game immerses you in the fascinating world of music and luthiery, where you have the opportunity to assemble, repair, and sell instruments with passion and precision. The recent improvements bring even more realism to this captivating adventure. Check out what's new!

[h3][b]Major Fixes:[/b][/h3]

Fixed Online Sales Issue: When you collected an instrument and then tried to sell it, the selling process sometimes didn't complete correctly. Now you can be confident that your online transactions will proceed as planned.

Paint Purchase from Orders List: Previously, there was a chance to acquire paints for free. This has been fixed, so you'll need to spend some money on your artistic inspirations once again.

Improved Pickguard and Plate Screws on Electric Guitar TL1: Now you can be sure that all elements of your electric guitar TL1 are properly secured and ready for a rock 'n' roll experience.

New Instruments classes: Now also old savegames can receive Orders with new Instruments classes.

Passing a day with no worries: Now no hard-lock stucks the game while passing a day, if there are wares to be delivered.

[h3][b]Minor Fixes:[/b][/h3]

Fixed Issue with Playing Bass PB4: You can now play the PB4 bass without any issues and enjoy those deep bass sounds.

Corrected Rotation Axes of Tuning Keys on Bass PB4: Tuning is now more precise than ever, ensuring perfect sound.

Fixed Nut Icons on PB4 Bass: All details are now in their proper place, regardless of your plans.

Improved Rendering of Metal Element on Headstock of PB4 Bass: Your savegames now look even better, without any inaccuracies.

Expanded Russian Localization: Our game is available worldwide, and now Russian players can enjoy an even better localization.

Automatic Camera Adjustment During String Assembly: The camera now works as it should, without disrupting your instrument-building process.

These updates bring even more realism to Music Store Simulator, making the game even more immersive. Now you can enjoy an even more authentic experience as a musician and luthier. Head over to Steam and see how these changes enhance your gaming experience!

[h3][b]🎸 Music Store Simulator Update - MONTH 3 🎸[/b][/h3]

📣 Hey there, fellow music shop tycoons! We're thrilled to announce the latest update for Music Store Simulator, set to rock your world on October 31st at 22:00 CET.

🤘 In this release, we've cranked up the volume with major and minor changes inspired by your awesome suggestions. We loved your input so much that we're dedicating an entire month to keep the player ideas flowing. Stay tuned for a revamped roadmap!

[h3][b]🔧 MAJOR CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

🛠️ Reserve Those Parts: We've introduced a slick new reservation system, making it a breeze to pre-assign parts to orders. No more guessing – your part count is crystal clear.

⏲️ Resting Options Refined: We've tweaked the resting options, introducing "Waiting for Delivery" and customizable choices to keep you in control.

🌈 Easier Paint Selection: We've revamped the paint color selection process, making it a piece of cake. The old method now becomes the "Advanced Mode" for pros.

🎲 Random Order Generation: The generation of new orders just got a makeover. Get ready for a whole new experience.

📦 Order Type Overhaul: We've shaken things up in the order department, adding fresh mechanics to keep you on your toes.

💰 Fine-Tune Your Earnings: You can now define instrument earnings and the gain of popularity points in the settings.

🎥 Camera Control: We've added an option to enable/disable camera movement during the unclamping process. It's all about control.

🎸 New Instruments: Rock on with the Electric Guitar TL1 (released on October 10th) and the Electric Bass PB4.

[h3][b]🔧 MINOR CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

🛠️ Weekend Work: Digital luthiers are now working on Saturdays too – more time for crafting awesome instruments!

🍯 Save Your Glue Choice: The game now remembers your last choice of glue, saving you the hassle of selecting it for each part.

⚙️ Electric Guitar PST Tweaks: The pickups are now screwed onto the pickguard, and the tremolo claw is attached to the body with just two screws.

🌟 Electric Guitar TL1 Updates: Pickups are now screwed onto the pickguard and the bridge – the ultimate sound experience.

[h3][b]🔧 MAJOR FIXES:[/b][/h3]

🎨 Paint Room Perfection: Fixed the pesky incorrect positioning issue for acoustic guitars Roundback and Dreadnought.

🖌️ Painting Room Revival: No more hiccups! We've sorted out the problem that was blocking the painting process.

🎥 Tutorial Troubles: Solved the issue with some tutorial video IDs that were causing problems – now you can watch them with ease.

[h3][b]🔧 MINOR FIXES:[/b][/h3]

🧰 Market App Efficiency: In Repair Orders, only the parts to be replaced will be displayed.

🎸 Tuning Key Tango: Fixed an error with the Tuning Key of TL1, allowing you to assemble those beauties with 4.4 stars.

🌟 "That's a Tune" Achievement: The counter is back on track – no more hiccups.

📊 Skills App Clarity: Skill progress now displays correctly when gaining a new star.

🖌️ Paint Panel Prowess: Fixed the paint count issue in the Preview panel on the first try – no more surprises!

[i]Get ready to dive back into the musical madness and make your music store empire even better! Let's rock and roll! 🎶🤟[/i]

Stay tuned for more updates and keep those awesome suggestions coming. We're here to make the Music Store Simulator the ultimate music shop experience. 🎵🎸🛒 

#MusicStoreSimulator #GameUpdate #RockOn

notes.title: HotFix #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42500031/452bb7b3901ead65b7e5786a565d4efdf8f8b3ff.png[/img]

[b]Hey Music Store Simulator Community![/b]

We're excited to announce the release of our second hotfix after the game's successful launch! We've been closely listening to your feedback and have been hard at work to improve your gaming experience. This hotfix includes a mix of minor changes, major fixes, and some minor fixes to address issues reported by our passionate players.

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Next Steps panel has been revamped! Now, elements are conveniently aggregated by category. Clicking on any element will automatically take you to the related Parts, making it easier to navigate through the game's mechanics.
[*] We've made modifications to Orders to ensure they no longer expire during the weekend. Now you can focus on your projects without any time constraints over the weekend!
[*] For those of you looking for a smoother experience, we've introduced the FPS Limit configuration. Head to the Settings window, and you can now set your preferred FPS limit (default value: 60).
[*] We understand how important convenience is, so we've added a handy feature. The game now remembers your last choice in terms of "Automatic Rotation" in the 3D Preview window.
[/list]

[b]Major Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The Clamps issue has been resolved! They were causing frustration by becoming unresponsive and preventing players from completing their projects. You can now clamp away without any worries!
[*] We've fixed a miscalculation problem with remaining 5-star Paints. They were stubbornly locked to 1 even if they were present in the warehouse. Now, the calculation is accurate, and you can make the most of your 5-star Paints!
[*] The Gluing process was causing some players to get stuck. Not anymore! We've identified and addressed the issue, so you can proceed smoothly with your projects.
[*] Saving key binding for the Moving Camera feature is now working as expected. No more headaches, just smooth camera control!
[*] The Classical guitar had an issue with the second layer of paint, causing project lock. Fear not, adjustments have been made to all acoustic instruments, and now you can paint your heart out!
[/list]

[b]Minor Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Audio bug with the Screw Clamp has been fixed. No more loop issues when clicking during camera transitions!
[*] Misalignment of Natural Tones in wood is no more! X or Y coordinate changes won't mess with your designs.
[*] Remaining hours before project expiry date in AR panels are now accurately calculated.
[*] Customer satisfaction calculation has been reworked for more precise results.
[*] You can no longer interact with instruments on shelves while working on the Workbench. No more accidental distractions!
[*] Ghost right mechanics of the Classical guitar have been correctly repositioned.
[*] 5-stars experience was being awarded for several Parts, but we've fixed it now.
[*] The calculation of incoming common Parts is now accurate.
[*] Russian and French localizations have been updated to ensure smooth gameplay for our players from those regions.
[/list]
[b]Patch Details:[/b]

The hotfix #2 will go live today at 23:00 CEST. We want to thank our amazing community for your support, feedback, and dedication to Music Store Simulator. Your passion drives us to create the best experience possible, and we'll continue working hard to make this game even better!

Stay tuned for more updates and keep sharing your thoughts on our official channels. [b]Rock on![/b]

Your Music Store Simulator Dev Team

notes.title: The date of Early Acces
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42500031/8df485f977d2cf4c81a15d414aae2bb46da82a2a.png[/img]

Hi all!
[h3]We have the date of Early Access start! On the next [b]July 24th[/b] the Early Access of Music Store Simulator will begin![/h3]

In the meanwhile, since the next June 20th the Steam PlayTest feature will be activated and players can subscribe the program, which will start on [b]July the 1st.[/b]

We plan to release a big update at the end of each month during the Early Access (obviously urgent fixes of blocking issues will be released as soon as possible, without waiting for the end of the month).

This the list of planned updates which will be released month by month. For each of these updates only the main new features have been listed, but all of them will contain several further minor new features (or updates) which will be detailed in a specific post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42500031/b5e83247559645ddff2182a1e6f74c4da662ad76.png[/img]

Also, each update will contain "[u][b]NEW CONTENTS[/b][/u]" (new instruments, new parts, new layouts, new Studio Logos) but their amount cannot be planned properly (also because we will work also on the eventual bugs). Obviously the detailed list of new contents will be shared within the specific post as well.

[list]
[*]Month 1 ([b]August 24th[/b]) - Repair Orders + Steam Achievements + new contents
[*]Month 2 ([b]September 30th[/b]) - Private Projects + Private Collection + new contents
[*]Month 3 ([b]October 31st[/b]) - All the best suggestions from players + new contents
[*]Month 4 ([b]November 30th[/b]) - Bank app + Finance app + new contents
[*]Month 5 ([b]December 31st[/b]) - Customization of Audio Playlist(*) + new contents
[*]Month 6 ([b]January 31st[/b]) - Soldering and wiring Electronics + new contents
[*]Month 7 ([b]February 29th[/b]) - Reworking of Soldering system + new contents
[*]Month 8 ([b]March 31st[/b]) - Warehouse Management app + Customization of Shelves names + new contents
[*]Month 9 ([b]April 30th[/b]) - All the best suggestions from players and notified fixes + new contents
[*]Month 10 ([b]May 31st[/b]) - Photographic Room + new contents
[*]Month 11 ([b]June 30th[/b]) - Adding custom Studio Logos + new contents
[*]Month 12 ([b]July 31st[/b]) - Opening Branches + Decals + new contents
[*]Month 13 ([b]August 24th[/b]) - Hiring employees(*) + new contents
[*]Month 14 ([b]September 30th[/b]) - Stats app + Special Tuning requirements + Rehearsal room rental + new contents
[*]Month 15 ([b]October 31st[/b]) - Retail system with NPC customers + new contents
[/list]
The features marked with (*) need further investigations and could be delayed or even canceled, if technical issues block their development.

Each update will be released for the PlayTest program 10 days before the related release date. All the feedbacks from testers, in terms of bug reports, modification or adjustments, will be implemented as soon as possible in order to meet the planned release date. If some implementation of minor fix is remaining, it will be released the next month.

This is our current plan and could be modified in the future, in case of tasks with higher priority, such as blocking bugs or good players' suggestions, which must be implemented immediately.
All the further valid suggestions and ideas will be added to the end of the list and will be implemented at the end of Early Access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42500031/1c1a92900eee08b8298aa65a25828de9829f5810.png[/img]
